title: SEC Revenue Leaders XBRL Frames
description: Optional credential: SEC_EDGAR_CONTACT overrides the default SEC fair-access User-Agent. SEC EDGAR doesn't issue API keys - it just wants a reachable email in the User-Agent string. Leave it unset and the script uses the SpeakesQuery default; set it (e.g. "your.name@example.com") to supply your own contact. Pulls quarterly revenue data for all publicly traded companies from SEC's XBRL frames API in a single request. Ranks companies by reported revenue and identifies quarter-over-quarter trends. Revenue is the top-line growth metric - companies consistently growing revenue above 20% YoY trade at premium valuations. Also captures the filing entity details for cross-referencing.
code:
import pandas as pd
import requests
import time
from datetime import datetime, timezone

contact = (CREDENTIALS.get('SEC_EDGAR_CONTACT') or '').strip()
if not contact or '@' not in contact:
    # SEC EDGAR's fair-access policy accepts any User-Agent that contains
    # a reachable email - it is NOT an API key / authentication token. Fall
    # back to the project default so scheduled SEC jobs run out of the box;
    # users can override by setting SEC_EDGAR_CONTACT in Settings → Credentials.
    contact = 'SpeakesQuery EDGAR (noreply@speakesquery.local)'
HEADERS = {'User-Agent': contact}
now_epoch = int(datetime.now(timezone.utc).timestamp())

# Determine the most recent completed quarter
now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
year = now.year
month = now.month
# Go back one quarter to ensure data is available
if month <= 3:
    q_year = year - 1
    quarter = 4
elif month <= 6:
    q_year = year
    quarter = 1
elif month <= 9:
    q_year = year
    quarter = 2
else:
    q_year = year
    quarter = 3

# Try current quarter first, fall back to prior quarter
concepts = [
    ('Revenues', f'CY{q_year}Q{quarter}', 'us-gaap'),
    ('RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax', f'CY{q_year}Q{quarter}', 'us-gaap'),
]

rows = []
seen_ciks = set()

for ci in range(len(concepts)):
    concept = concepts[ci][0]
    period = concepts[ci][1]
    taxonomy = concepts[ci][2]

    url = f'https://data.sec.gov/api/xbrl/frames/{taxonomy}/{concept}/USD/{period}.json'
    resp = requests.get(url, headers=HEADERS, timeout=30)
    if resp.status_code != 200:
        continue
    data = resp.json()

    entries = data.get('data', [])
    for entry in entries:
        cik = int(entry.get('cik', 0))
        if cik in seen_ciks:
            continue
        seen_ciks.add(cik)

        val = float(entry.get('val', 0))
        if val <= 0:
            continue

        rows.append({
            'cik': cik,
            'entity_name': entry.get('entityName', ''),
            'concept': concept,
            'period': period,
            'revenue_usd': val,
            'revenue_billions': round(val / 1_000_000_000, 2),
            'accession': entry.get('accn', ''),
            'filed_date': entry.get('filed', ''),
            'form': entry.get('form', ''),
            'fiscal_year': entry.get('fy', 0),
            'fiscal_period': entry.get('fp', ''),
            '_epoch': now_epoch,
        })

    time.sleep(0.15)

df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
if not df.empty:
    df = df.sort_values('revenue_usd', ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)
GENERATE_RESULTS(df)
